observed_bottleneck: The Parent has no cross-round reward memory: every one of its 145 optimizer records uses only the five elites from the immediately observed batch of ten and then drops those scored trajectories. Node n-6174d6127af5 shows that this current-batch-only signal is fragile: only 125/145 updates increased likelihood on their selected trajectories, sitagliptin_mpo was positive on only 18/29 updates, and the two weakest final task values were 0.19882131306757464 on median_2 and 0.2590041376695029 on sitagliptin_mpo even though novel-valid sampling yield remained 0.8396073778448927. Cross-round reuse is operationally feasible in campaign evidence: n-a5a9c7e8871a reused 1,346 adaptive trajectories after their creation batch, while n-f316eae4e271 measured a 0.22487942715802353 rank advantage from reward-prioritized rather than uniform replay.
hypothesis: Add one bounded, task-local reward-prioritized experience memory to the Parent's Augmented Hill-Climb update: retain the 50 highest-scoring unique accepted agent trajectories and, at each later feedback round, train on the five highest-scoring trajectories that predate the current round alongside the unchanged current-batch elite half, using each stored oracle score in the same frozen-prior reward-augmented likelihood target.
method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.
